risk: Block-internal n-1 cannot be removed by any filtration mode; final full-length purity is floored at the product of block full-length fractions.
mitigation: Control at creation: high block full-length purity + high ligation conversion. Block-stage IEX/RP polishing (at supplier, on short blocks where 1 nt is easier to resolve). Accept a single final strand polish only if DS spec exceeds the achievable floor.
notes: Core of finding 1. Confirmed by A, B, C+D.

risk: Immobilised-ligase clearance by filtration is unproven at scale; if it fails, enzyme removal reverts to chromatography (affinity/IEX), breaking the filtration-led thesis.
mitigation: Develop and qualify immobilised or solid-phase ligase with measured residual-protein clearance; keep a chromatographic enzyme-removal fallback in the concept.

risk: Duplex may dissociate or degrade during atomisation/drying if particle temperature approaches the melting temperature.
mitigation: Trehalose amorphous glass; keep outlet temperature below duplex Tm AND keep the powder below its moisture-shifted Tg, which measured 38-53 C at 3.8-4.6% residual moisture - far below the anhydrous-trehalose value. Drive residual moisture down to raise Tg. N2 low-oxygen drying. Fallback: dry single strands separately and anneal downstream.
notes: Duplex preserved when outlet temp < Tm (bench). Our Tm = GAP (Q-030). Post-drying thermal margin is tighter than previously stated and binds on storage as well as drying (Q-039).

risk: Thermal degradation of product in the evaporator from residence-time x temperature.
mitigation: Short-residence type (falling/wiped/thin film, residence seconds) under vacuum to hold temperature low; avoid forced circulation (long residence).

risk: Non-volatile buffer salts (Tris/Mg/NaCl) concentrate through evaporation into the powder unless the final diafiltration exchanges into a spray-dry-compatible matrix.
mitigation: Final DF into excipient + minimal/volatile salt matrix (BUF-FINAL) before evaporation/drying.

risk: Splint removal would be infeasible by filtration if a foreign same-chemistry splint were used.
mitigation: Use the complementary product strand as the splint (siRNA sticky-end route); avoid a sacrificial foreign splint. If unavoidable, DNase digestion (adds a protein impurity to clear).

risk: Endotoxin clearance by membrane adsorber is unproven for a polyanionic oligonucleotide feed (product competes for charged sites).
mitigation: Low-bioburden operation, endotoxin-controlled reagents/water, hold-time limits; qualify positively-charged/guanidinium adsorbers experimentally.
notes: Top endotoxin gap; protein-feed data only.

risk: Spray dryer and evaporator are hard to clean (wall deposits, cyclone product); CIP/SIP validation for low-bioburden operation is demanding.
mitigation: Design CIP/SIP with the vendor; consider single-use contact where feasible; cleaning validation with worst-case soils.

risk: Aqueous intermediates with growth-promoting buffers support microbial growth during holds.
mitigation: Refrigerated storage, limited hold times, bioburden-reduction filtration into sanitised vessels for extended holds; bioburden/endotoxin monitoring.
notes: Bioburden tightens 100 -> 10 CFU/10 mL toward DS.

risk: Adenylylated dead-end (AppN) species (~329 Da difference) cannot be removed by filtration.
mitigation: Enzyme/ATP selection to suppress AppN (e.g., dsRNA ligases, controlled ATP); control at reaction, not downstream.

risk: Membrane area and yield are sized on protein and plasmid-DNA surrogate flux from a weak secondary source; no oligonucleotide-specific flux or recovery figure exists.
mitigation: Measure flux, fouling and recovery on the real stream at bench and pilot scale before fixing membrane area; treat all current LMH figures as placeholders.
notes: See Q-036. The previously cited ~80% RNA recovery figure does not exist in the cited source.

risk: Microbial and endotoxin limits in this knowledge base are carried over from mammalian cell-culture practice and are unverified for an oligonucleotide drug substance.
mitigation: Obtain the oligonucleotide-specific microbiological control paper and replace the ladder; until then do not use these numbers as specifications.
